title: Silas and the Horizon
author: Paloma Lockridge
blurb: Gideon Brightwater, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
